items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I wonder to ask you, when did you switch to this band system, Cullen actually got down?

ctx.x: Brother, yes. That's all, just brother. Brother William. We had a nickname, uh, nickname William. Well that's my middle name, William. But they used to call my daddy William, so they'd call me brother William. And, with that cornbread, the game was from my school days and it's been still ever since.
Well, I wonder to ask you, when did you switch to this band system, Cullen actually got down?
Well, that was when I was playing at the H and J Tavern. Now, it was during the war, World War II I believe.
